gate_a.why_retired: D206, on this script's own reasoning: overrun = (b - SAFETY_FACTOR) * service has the sign of (b - SAFETY_FACTOR) alone, so the count is 0 or N and never in between. The old 0 of 6 was an identity because q90 equalled max; N of N at the max bias is an identity of the opposite sign. Replacing the input made the QUANTILE real and did not make the COUNT informative. The column is kept and labelled so a reader can see why it was retired, not merely that it went.
